entities.name: UniProt Q5QXL9
observations: Exact 98-aa sequence match to reviewed Idiomarina loihiensis integration host factor (IHF) subunit alpha; calculated mass 11,140.5 Da and pI 7.97.

Annotated as a DNA-binding IHF subunit involved in genetic recombination and regulation of transcription and translation; GO includes DNA binding, cytosol, recombination, and gene-expression regulation.
Pfam detects Bac_DNA_binding (PF00216.27; residues 3–91) and HU-HIG (PF18291.7; residues 6–94).
